articles.title: Crowds Brawl With Recruiters In Lviv In Latest Clash Over Mobilization
articles.summary: A brawl erupted in Lviv, western Ukraine, on July 8, between Ukrainian military recruiters and local residents as officers detained men who failed to register for duty. Authorities opened a criminal investigation. Russia was accused of using propaganda to incite unrest. articles.title: Andy Burnham on the verge of becoming U.K. PM

articles.title: Trump Says US Agrees To Further Talks With Iran, But Warns Cease-Fire Is 'Over'
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump agreed to further talks with Iran. He warned Tehran the cease-fire is over. articles.title: Russia Targets Ukrainian Gas Stations With Drone Strikes
articles.summary: Russian forces destroyed over 150 Ukrainian gas stations using Geran-2 drones in three months. articles.title: Indonesia is rewriting the emerging-market inflation playbook
articles.summary: Indonesia rewrites the inflation playbook by not hiking interest rates. For over three decades, the standard playbook for taming inflation has remained virtually unchanged. articles.title: New cholera outbreak alert for Sudan’s war-weary communities
articles.summary: Sudan's war-torn areas face a new cholera outbreak with over 100 dead. New cholera outbreak alert for Sudan’s war-weary communities.

articles.title: US showdown with India’s global gangsters
articles.summary: The US indicted Lawrence Bishnoi and Satinderjeet Singh for directing the 2023 assassination of Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada. The US decision to indict jailed Indian gangster Lawrence Bishnoi and his alleged North American associate, Satinderjeet Singh (“Goldy Brar”), for allegedly directing the 2023 assassination of Sikh activist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada is more than another organized crime prosecution.

articles.title: Rift Over World War II-Era Killings Rocks Crucial Ukraine-Poland Ties
articles.summary: Poland and Ukraine's ties are strained over World War II-era killings at a crucial time in Ukraine's defense against Russia. Poland, steeped in bad memories of the 1939 Nazi-Soviet invasion and decades of dominance from Moscow after World War II, is a firm backer of Ukraine’s defense against Russia. But a flare-up over their own bloody history is threatening ties at a crucial time -- and could have wide repercussions.

articles.title: Diplomats go virtual to witness Gaza displacement site up close
articles.summary: Representatives from 12 countries conducted a "virtual diplomatic field visit" to a Gaza displacement site. They heard from residents about their pressing needs. Representatives from 12 countries carried out a “virtual diplomatic field visit” to a displacement site in the Gaza Strip and heard from some of the residents about their pressing needs, the United Nations said on Thursday.

articles.title: Use of explosive weapons ‘must stop’ in eastern DR Congo: Türk
articles.summary: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk urged the Democratic Republic of the Congo's armed forces and the Rwanda-backed M23 group to cease hostilities following recent civilian deaths. He deplored the violence in eastern DR Congo. The conflict has resulted in numerous casualties. UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk urged the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group to cease hostilities as he deplored recent civilian deaths on Thursday.

articles.title: US-Iran war leaves shipping at near-standstill in Hormuz again
articles.summary: The US-Iran war brought shipping to a near-standstill in the Strait of Hormuz, stranding 6,000 seafarers. US-Iran war leaves shipping at near-standstill in Hormuz again.

articles.summary: The UN Security Council called for urgent de-escalation amid a spike in civilian deaths from Russian drone attacks. articles.title: Remembering the Srebrenica genocide: ‘Fear is all that kept me moving’
articles.summary: The United Nations paused to remember the over 8,000 Bosnian Muslim men and boys killed in Srebrenica in July 1995. The United Nations paused on Wednesday to remember the more than 8,000 Bosnian Muslim men and boys killed in the town of Srebrenica in July 1995, and the women and survivors left to rebuild their lives in the aftermath.

articles.title: US-Iran ceasefire collapse all about control of Hormuz
articles.summary: The US struck 80 targets in Iran after Iranian forces fired on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. articles.title: तेल के लिए तरस रहे, रूस के पहले राष्ट्रपति भी सोच रहे होंगे कि किसको उत्तराधिकारी बना दिया?
articles.summary: यूक्रेन के राष्ट्रपति वोलोदिमीर जेलेंस्की ने रूस पर तंज कसा, कहा कि रूस खुद तेल मंगवाने के लिए दर-दर भटक रहा है, जबकि वह कभी दुनिया को तेल-गैस बेचने वाला देश था। यह बयान रूस की वर्तमान स्थिति को उजागर करता है। यूक्रेन के राष्ट्रपति वोलोदिमीर जेलेंस्की ने रूस पर करारा तंज कसा है। उन्होंने कहा कि रूस, जो कभी दुनिया को तेल-गैस बेचने वाला देश था, आज खुद तेल मंगवाने के लिए दर-दर भटक रहा है।

articles.summary: इजरायल के प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने कहा कि इजरायल अमेरिका के अलावा अन्य बड़ी ताकतों के साथ नए रणनीतिक गठबंधन बना रहा है. उन्होंने भारत का जिक्र करते हुए कहा कि भारत में इजरायल को जबरदस्त समर्थन मिल रहा है. यह बयान अमेरिका-इजरायल रिश्तों में बढ़ती तल्खी के बीच आया है. India Israel Relations: अमेरिका और इजरायल के रिश्तों में बढ़ती तल्खी के बीच इजरायल के प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू का एक बयान चर्चा में है.
